title: A principal-only interest-payment waiver on a CHARGED-OFF loan credits INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST and debits INTEREST_ON_LOANS (loan 13 L76: credit 46.56, debit 46.56)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_PAYMENT_WAIVER posted on loan 13 (product LP2_ADV_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INTEREST_RECALC_ZERO_CHARGE_OF_ACCRUAL) when the loan was MARKED CHARGED OFF on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 76 (externalId L76): principalPortion 46.56 -> "4656", interest 0, fee 0, penalty 0, overpayment 0. charged_off is the read-back's top-level chargedOff true. accounts is the product mapping from create-request-LP2_ADV_INTEREST_DAILY_EMI_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_INTEREST_RECALC_ZERO_CHARGE_OF_ACCRUAL.json (sha256 8e8b8d5a...28a1), which agrees with LP1 on every relevant slot: loanPortfolio 2, receivables 4, overpayment 17, interestOnLoan 9, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 20. expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs transcribes the two L76 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 185 CREDIT account 20 46.56, JE 186 DEBIT account 9 46.56. THIS VECTOR GRADES: a principal-only charged-off waiver against a SECOND product, so a port that hardcodes one product or misroutes a single charged-off portion fails. Nothing was computed; the exact decimal 46.56 parses to the integer minor unit 4656, never a float.
